question: For building 36, list all space units, their floor and building name, building street address, their space usage, and the number of organizations and space units on the same building and floor.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "building_addresses" AS SELECT 
  b.building_key,
  b.building_number,
  b.building_name,
  b.building_street_address
FROM beaver.buildings b

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "rooms" AS WITH rooms_base AS (
  SELECT 
    r.building_key,
    b.building_number,
    b.building_name,
    b.building_street_address,
    r.floor,
    r.room,
    /* Prefer provided building_room if present, otherwise concat */
    COALESCE(r.room_full_name, r.building_room, CONCAT(b.building_number, '-', r.room)) AS building_room,
    r.space_id,
    r.use_desc,
    r.major_use_desc,
    r.organization_key,
    r.organization_name
  FROM beaver.fac_rooms r
  JOIN beaver.buildings b
    ON b.building_key = r.building_key
  WHERE b.building_number = '36'
)
SELECT * FROM rooms_base

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "rooms" AS WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    r.building_key,
    b.building_number,
    b.building_name,
    b.building_street_address,
    r.floor,
    r.room,
    r.space_id,
    r.use_desc,
    r.major_use_desc,
    r.organization_key,
    r.organization_name
  FROM beaver.fac_rooms r
  JOIN beaver.buildings b
    ON b.building_key = r.building_key
  WHERE b.building_number = '36'
), with_fclt AS (
  SELECT 
    base.*,
    fr.building_room AS fr_building_room,
    fr.room_full_name AS fr_room_full_name
  FROM base
  LEFT JOIN beaver.fclt_rooms fr
    ON fr.fclt_building_key = base.building_key
   AND fr.floor = base.floor
   AND fr.room = base.room
)
SELECT 
  building_key,
  building_number,
  building_name,
  building_street_address,
  floor,
  room,
  COALESCE(fr_room_full_name, fr_building_room, CONCAT(building_number, '-', room)) AS building_room,
  space_id,
  use_desc,
  major_use_desc,
  organization_key,
  organization_name
FROM with_fclt

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "building_addresses__fixed" AS SELECT 
  CAST(building_key AS VARCHAR) AS building_key,

  CAST(building_name AS VARCHAR) AS building_name,

  CAST(building_name AS VARCHAR) AS building_name,
  CAST(building_street_address AS VARCHAR) AS building_street_address,

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
        r.building_number,
        r.building_name,
        r.building_street_address,
        r.floor,
        r.room,
        COALESCE(r.building_room, CONCAT(r.building_number, '-', r.room)) AS building_room,
        r.space_id,
        r.use_desc,
        r.major_use_desc,
        r.organization_key,
        r.organization_name
    FROM rooms r
    WHERE r.building_number = '36'
), counts AS (
    SELECT 
        building_number,
        floor,
        COUNT(*) AS space_units_on_floor,
        COUNT(DISTINCT organization_key) AS organizations_on_floor
    FROM base
    GROUP BY building_number, floor
)
SELECT 
    b.building_room AS space_unit,
    b.floor,
    b.building_name,
    b.building_street_address,
    b.use_desc AS space_usage,
    c.organizations_on_floor,
    c.space_units_on_floor
FROM base b
JOIN counts c
  ON b.building_number = c.building_number AND b.floor = c.floor
ORDER BY b.floor, b.room
LIMIT 200;
